notes.title: New Track in Demo: DEMOLITION TOWER
notes.content:
DEMOLITION TOWER is now available in version 0.8.36! This update introduces a new level set in a crumbling city sector slated for demolition.

https://i.imgur.com/rAnnwe6.gif

The game has received major optimizations on Steam Deck and other lower-performance devices. 
New objects, extended Rain City background, improved Grass Mountains background with more props:

https://i.imgur.com/tv3aHP7.gif

Patch notes:

 New level: Demolition Tower.
 New level objects: Doors, outdoor AC units, various shattered concrete blocks and metal poles.
 Grass Mountains theme background buildings and animations added.
 Hot Lava theme graphical effects improved.
 Rain City theme background extended.
 Performance optimizations. 
 Faster level restart.


- Baron

notes.title: New Track in Demo: OXIDE RING
notes.content:
OXIDE RING is now available in version 0.8.33! Introducing a gloomy new level set in the rain-drenched vista of Rain City. On the gameplay front "helmet-first" finishes are now supported thanks to more accurate bike collision shapes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40314603/9ea60caaec2c2d44cd2082b4647296c14da6582b.png

Patch notes:

 New level: Oxide Ring.
 New level theme: Rain City.
 New level objects: water flows, glows.
 New polished version of 'Stacks' level with animated grass and background details.


https://i.imgur.com/OTosIep.gif

- Baron

notes.title: New Track in Demo: INFERNAL
notes.content:
INFERNAL is now available in version 0.8.27! Bringing a scorching new challenge set in a landscape of lava. A new gameplay mechanic makes sure you'll burst into flames if you're not careful:

https://i.imgur.com/5TLjDgi.gif

Patch notes:

 New level: Infernal.
 New level theme: Lava.
 Hover platforms. (Can be tested in the Joker card level)
 17 graffiti objects.
 Bunch of new neon sign props.
 Improved bike destruction details: oil starts leaking & new smoke effects.


Version 0.8.26 added fan objects that can boost the bike's speed... or swing the ragdoll faster:
https://i.imgur.com/fpdvnCR.gif

Version 0.8.24 added some new level background assets:
https://i.imgur.com/Kf7zhHw.png

Also, the HUD can now be disabled in the settings for a more immersive experience.

- Baron

notes.title: New Track: DREADMILL
notes.content:
DREADMILL is now available in version 0.8.22! This track throws you into an relentless gauntlet of grinding gears. A fresh leaderboard is live, so there’s a new #1 spot up for grabs!

https://i.imgur.com/jURea9I.gif

Patch notes:

 Improved background animations: neon signs, flying cars, hover trains, moving construction cranes, factories with billowing smoke, pumpjacks, strange gadgets, etc.
 Optimizations, especially Steam Deck: 2× better performance in the most demanding levels, increased resolution, and more effects.
 Four different ways the bike can break: front wheel off, back wheel off, both off, bike intact.
 Improved PlayStation controller support.
 New background theme.
 Joker card has a taste of a new level.


https://i.imgur.com/0yeRbCN.gif

(Version 0.8.19 previously added the Cloudpiercer level.)

- Baron

notes.title: Ultrawide support!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/deETxVX.gif

Ultrawide support for aspect ratios up to 32:9 now in the game, as requested on the Steam forums.

Also, an upcoming track is in the works, created to the old-timer level building tune The Ground Is At A Great Distance*.

https://i.imgur.com/u73Z1Op.gif

Want to show support for the game? A great way to do that is to leave a review for the demo. It helps the algorithm on Steam pick the game up.

Enjoy your holidays and I'll see you all on the leaderboard!

* The original tune has been lost in time, sadly.

-Kimmo-
